requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-FUN-001 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The system shall provide outdoor air to the room through the supply-air path and discharge room air through the exhaust path.
requirements.text: The system shall provide outdoor air to the room through the supply-air path and discharge room air through the exhaust path.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-FUN-002 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air mass flow using measured room CO2 concentration as feedback.
requirements.text: The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air mass flow using measured room CO2 concentration as feedback.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-FUN-003 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The occupied-room CO2 concentration shall not exceed 1000 ppm under the design occupancy schedule.
requirements.text: The occupied-room CO2 concentration shall not exceed 1000 ppm under the design occupancy schedule.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-FUN-004 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The outdoor-air CO2 concentration used by the demonstration model shall be 300 ppm.
requirements.text: The outdoor-air CO2 concentration used by the demonstration model shall be 300 ppm.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-FUN-005 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: CO2 generation shall be proportional to the number of occupants scheduled in the room.
requirements.text: CO2 generation shall be proportional to the number of occupants scheduled in the room.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-PER-001 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The controlled room air volume shall be 100 m^3.
requirements.text: The controlled room air volume shall be 100 m^3.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-PER-002 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The nominal air density for ventilation mass-flow conversion shall be 1.2 kg/m^3.
requirements.text: The nominal air density for ventilation mass-flow conversion shall be 1.2 kg/m^3.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-PER-003 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: Each occupant shall contribute 8.18E-6 kg/s of CO2 at the design activity level.
requirements.text: Each occupant shall contribute 8.18E-6 kg/s of CO2 at the design activity level.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-PER-004 | Source / Rev: MOD-NT-03 | Requirement Text: The peopleSource implementation shall use a trace-substance concentration parameter of 100 kg/kg and a carrier mass-flow command equal to occupant CO2 generation divided by 100.
requirements.text: The peopleSource implementation shall use a trace-substance concentration parameter of 100 kg/kg and a carrier mass-flow command equal to occupant CO2 generation divided by 100.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-PER-005 | Source / Rev: MOD-NT-03 | Requirement Text: The nominal trace-substance concentration used for equation scaling shall be 1.519E-3 kg/kg.
requirements.text: The nominal trace-substance concentration used for equation scaling shall be 1.519E-3 kg/kg.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-PER-006 | Source / Rev: URS-IAQ-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The fresh-air concentration of 300 ppm shall be represented as 0.3 times the nominal 1000 ppm mass fraction.
requirements.text: The fresh-air concentration of 300 ppm shall be represented as 0.3 times the nominal 1000 ppm mass fraction.
